summary: Targeted LDP sessions can be started by a router for many reasons, but until now the router receiving the request had no way to know why and so could not decide whether to accept it. This document defines a way for a router to advertise which targeted applications it is willing to accept sessions for, so unwanted sessions can be refused.

eli5.summary: Imagine a door that anyone can knock on. This lets the house post a sign saying which kinds of visitors are welcome, so it can politely turn the rest away.

questions: how does a router limit which targeted ldp sessions it accepts
